name: John Mannion
bio: a Representative from New York; born in Syracuse, Onondaga County, N.Y., July 8, 1968; graduated from Bishop Ludden Junior-Senior High School, Syracuse, N.Y., 1986; B.A., Binghamton University, Binghamton, N.Y.; M.S., State University of New York at Oswego, Oswego, N.Y.; teacher; member of the New York state senate; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
